subject: website
name: Piece of π
summary: The project page of a free-mint generative collection. No public source was found. It is Level 2: when the page opens it loads ethers from cdn.ethers.io, Tailwind from cdn.tailwindcss.com and React from unpkg.com, all with no integrity hash, and its top image comes from a Pinata gateway.

connections.note: The top image, fetched when the page opens.
